acceptance_criteria: Both gheimeh stew and eggplant identity must be present or source title explicitly identifies gheimeh bademjan.
reject_examples: Plain khoresh bademjan; generic eggplant stew; gheimeh without eggplant.

acceptance_criteria: Plain Persian steamed white rice/chelo, ideally plated or pot-cooked with recognizable separate grains.
reject_examples: Mixed rice, pilaf with vegetables, biryani or generic stock rice photo without Persian context.

acceptance_criteria: Dill/fava-bean rice and lamb shank must both be visible or explicitly named by source.
reject_examples: Baghali polo alone; lamb shank alone; generic rice and meat.

acceptance_criteria: Lentil porridge/soup used as Iranian breakfast; source context or visual consistency required.
reject_examples: Camera products, thin generic lentil soup without Iranian identity.

acceptance_criteria: Iranian head-and-feet breakfast dish; visible components or explicit source identity.
reject_examples: Khash/paça without Iranian identity; restaurant sign; offal market only.

acceptance_criteria: Iranian/Bandari sambooseh identity; triangular fried pastry with source context.
reject_examples: Generic South Asian samosa unless source explicitly identifies Iranian/Bandari variant.

acceptance_criteria: Iranian shami patty identity; source or recipe context must distinguish it from South Asian shami kebab.
reject_examples: Generic South Asian shami kebab; unrelated meat patties.

acceptance_criteria: Iranian pinto-bean khorak, typically tomato-based and plated/bowled.
reject_examples: Mexican/Western baked beans; generic bean salad.

acceptance_criteria: Iranian Salad Olivieh plate or sandwich; source context should indicate Persian/Iranian form.
reject_examples: Generic Russian Olivier without Iranian context; unrelated potato salad.

acceptance_criteria: Plain Iranian yogurt bowl/product with source context.
reject_examples: Fruit yogurt, flavored yogurt, non-Iranian product with no relevance.

acceptance_criteria: Iranian strained yogurt/mast chekideh; product or bowl should be visibly thick and source-contextualized.
reject_examples: Generic labneh only; Greek yogurt without Iranian identity.

acceptance_criteria: Southern Iranian dark herb/tamarind fish stew; fish and stew context required.
reject_examples: Generic fish curry/stew; grilled fish; shrimp-only ghalieh.

acceptance_criteria: Dizi served/cooked in a stone pot, or source explicitly identifies dizi sangi.
reject_examples: Restaurant exterior; empty pot; generic abgoosht in non-stone vessel.

acceptance_criteria: Mazandaran Akbar Joojeh: fried chicken portion, typically saffron rice and pomegranate sauce/context.
reject_examples: Generic fried chicken; roast chicken; restaurant logo only.

acceptance_criteria: Kermanshahi/Persian rib kebab with source or regional context.
reject_examples: Generic barbecue ribs; non-Iranian rib dishes.

acceptance_criteria: Thick Iranian ash with grain, legumes, herbs and meat; source identity required.
reject_examples: Generic ash/soup; logos; unrelated ceremonial images.

acceptance_criteria: Iranian potato kuku: egg-potato patty/frittata, source or visual context.
reject_examples: Hash browns, potato pancakes without Iranian identity, tortilla española.
